Proof initialized successfully in <workspace>
Conjecture: All primes greater than 2 are odd
Author: capture

Next steps:
  1. af status    - View the proof tree (root node '1' is your conjecture)
  2. af jobs      - See available work (root is now a verifier job)
  3. af claim 1   - Claim the root node to start working

Workflow overview:
  - New nodes start as VERIFIER jobs (ready for review)
  - Verifiers either ACCEPT nodes or raise CHALLENGES
  - Challenged nodes become PROVER jobs (need refinement)
  - Provers use REFINE to break down claims into substeps
  - The cycle repeats until all nodes are accepted

Quick reference:
  Verifier commands: af accept, af challenge
  Prover commands:   af refine, af amend, af resolve-challenge
  Info commands:     af get <id>, af schema, af inferences
